title: A part number already stocked here and active is refused
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Active part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-DUPACT-01) is stocked at {Location-A}.
  • {Number-A} (for example zzautotest-pl-dupact-01) is {Part-A} typed in lower case.
  • {Number-B} (for example zzautotest pl*dup.act 01) equals {Part-A} once upper and lower case, hyphens, asterisks, periods and spaces are ignored.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Parts → Inventory and click New Inventory Part.
  2. Type a Description (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL Dup Try).
  3. Type {Number-A} in Part Number.
  4. Pick any Category (for example Uncategorized).
  5. Type a Cost (for example 10.00).
  6. Click Save.
  7. Replace the Part Number with {Number-B}.
  8. Click Save.
  9. Click Cancel.
  10. Type {Part-A} in the Inventory search.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 6: the part is not saved. A red message reads "{Part-A} already exists at this location." It names the number of the part already there, in that part's own upper and lower case, not {Number-A} as typed. A second, smaller line under it reads "Please try to resolve this." The message goes away after about 3 seconds, and the window stays open with the typed values.
  • Step 8: the same red message "{Part-A} already exists at this location." appears: hyphens, asterisks, periods and spaces make no difference.
  • Step 9: the window closes.
  • Step 10: still exactly one row, {Part-A}.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S7-N3, S7-N5, §4 Key Decisions, §8 User Feedback Summary, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.5 (The same number again, in lower case), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S7-N3: “If a part with the same number is already stocked at this location and is active, the save is refused with "{part number} already exists at this location."”
  • S7-N5: “For S7-N3 and S7-N4, "the same number" ignores upper and lower case, hyphens, asterisks, periods, spaces and other blank characters. The message names the number of the part already there.”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (New part's number already stocked here, active): “"{part number} already exists at this location." | Error toast, fades after 3 seconds”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary context note: “every refusal sent by the system, the rows that fade after 3 seconds, also shows a second, smaller line under the message: "Please try to resolve this."”
  • PRD §4 Key Decisions (duplicate at the location): “A new part number already stocked at the location is refused, ignoring case and punctuation. This check stops a second copy of a part at one location. It runs when a part is created or its number is changed, never when a part is saved with its number unchanged.”
